description.value: HiFive Chicken is a BC-born fast-food chain established in 2016 that has grown from a single Vancouver location to over 11 outlets across the Lower Mainland. The menu centres on freshly marinated fried and roasted chicken served in pieces, family platters, and sandwiches, alongside sides like poutine and maple chive biscuits. The chain also runs a dedicated boxed lunch program, making it a practical stop for cyclists looking to fuel up or stock up for the road.

address.value: 8669 East Tenth Avenue, North Vancouver, BC
